notes: Song Index on pdf pp3-9 ('page Title - performer', 2 columns) OCR'd per column at 300 dpi; performer index follows (pp10-14), not used. Printed page = pdfPage+1 (offset -1) for most of the book. OCR often dropped the hundreds digit of page numbers, so pages were fixed by matching the title against OCR of the top of every pdf page (205 entries matched with high score, conf high); the rest (conf med) use the OCR'd index number minus 1, or a page between neighbouring confirmed entries when the number was damaged, so they may be off by one (several tunes share a page, and the title of a second tune is not at the page top so cannot be matched). Inverted titles (', The') moved to the front. Index lacks composers (lists performers). Checked on pages: ~25 by OCR sample (e.g. A Felicidade p30, After Hours p31, All Blues p38, All Or Nothing p40).
